answer: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.CRP = '+' AND T1.Description IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Examination WHERE Thrombosis = 2 AND "ANA Pattern" = 'S' AND "aCL IgM" > (SELECT AVG("aCL IgM") FROM Examination) * 1.2
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Laboratory AS T1 INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.SM IN ('negative', '0') AND T2.Thrombosis = 0
SELECT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Diagnosis FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.Thrombosis = 2
SELECT COUNT(ID) FROM Patient WHERE SEX = 'F' AND STRFTIME('%Y', Description) = '1997' AND Admission = '-'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.Thrombosis = 1 AND STRFTIME('%Y', T2."Examination Date") = '1997' AND T1.SEX = 'F'
SELECT T2."aCL IgM" FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE' AND T1.Description = '1994-02-19' AND T2."Examination Date" = '1993-11-12'
SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.Admission = '-' AND T2.Date LIKE '1991-10%' AND T2."T-BIL" < 2.0
SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID, T1.SEX, STRFTIME('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.GLU >= 180 AND T2."T-CHO" < 250
SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.Date BETWEEN '1987-07-06' AND '1996-01-31' AND T2.GPT > 30 AND T2.ALB < 4
